name: alter-ego-pwa
description: A PWA + Electron Desktop variant of L4w1i3t's ALTER EGO program.

scripts.lint: echo 'ESLint temporarily disabled - TypeScript provides type checking'
scripts.lint:fix: echo 'ESLint temporarily disabled - use Prettier for formatting'
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build-prod
scripts.ci:full: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run build-prod
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build-dev && electron .
scripts.electron:build: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build-prod && npm run electron:signing:check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
scripts.electron:build:win: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build-prod && node scripts/prepare-electron-signing.js --platform=win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build-prod && node scripts/prepare-electron-signing.js --platform=linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux
scripts.electron:build:linux:arch: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build-prod && node scripts/prepare-electron-signing.js --platform=linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux pacman
scripts.electron:build:linux:tar: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build-prod && node scripts/prepare-electron-signing.js --platform=linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux tar.gz
scripts.electron:build:unsigned: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_SKIP_SIGNING=true npm run electron:build
scripts.experiment:build: cd experiments && npm install && npm run build

author: L4w1i3t
